cohort: A sample of 1,200 women selected from hospital discharge records of approximately 2,400 mother-infant pairs following live births at a large, urban obstetric hospital in Ireland.
finding: Sixty-one per cent of women responded to the PRAMS Ireland survey, and women aged <30, single women, multiparous women, and women with a preterm delivery were less likely to respond.
cross-section timing: Data was collected post-delivery, based on hospital discharge records of live births, with a survey response period of 133 days after the initial invitation.
